operator_level_dedup: All German HUMANA Second Hand shops operated by HUMANA Second Hand Kleidung GmbH count as one supplier. Hamburg, Berlin, Potsdam, Dresden, Leipzig, Cologne and other German branches are not counted separately. HUMANA Spain / FUNDACIÓN PUEBLO PARA PUEBLO is a distinct legal operator and remains a separate supplier identity.
reason: Independent PASS2 confirms a current German professional second-hand/vintage apparel network. The current first-party site states that HUMANA Second Hand operates 34 shops in Germany, including five in Hamburg, and explicitly markets second-hand and vintage apparel. Current 2026 offer/news pages document daily new second-hand pieces, current collections and active nationwide shops. The first-party imprint identifies HUMANA Second Hand Kleidung GmbH, Hoppegarten, HR B 12920 FF, VAT DE178817297 and managing director Jytte Nielsen. The current model reviewed is physical retail; no current item-level remote purchase catalogue or ordinary delivery to Spain was established for this German legal operator, so it is VERIFIED_HOLD rather than operationally eligible.
